other.code: PAW-PBE, GGA, cutoff 600 eV, k-mesh 2x2x2, force convergence 1e-4 eV/Ang

evidence.quote: For structural optimization and elastic properties calculations, we used VASP. The PAW -PBE potential [47] with generalized gradient approximation (GGA) for the exchange correlation potential was adopted. We used a relatively high energy cutoff of 600 eV, with electronic and ionic force convergence se t at 10 -6 eV and 10 -4 eV/Å respectively with 2×2×2 k-point mesh.

For elastic properties using VASP, we used the stress (σ j) and strain (ε i) response analysis scheme [48, 49] on the fully relaxed structure and applied a small strain ε (± 0.25%) to obtain the elastic coefficients Cij and compliance tensor Sij

mechanisms.name: M-M metallic bonding and M-C covalent bonding

evidence.quote: The M 23C6 carbides tend to have strong, short covalent bonds between the metal and carbon atoms (M -C). They also have metallic bonding between TMs which is very different from covalent or ionic bonding in insulators.
